scope: 22 targeted browser tests after the equipped traversal change; the complete 44-test browser suite was not rerun.

selectedTests.title: traversal preview starts paused and animates four real equipped clips without altering the master
production traversal preview exposes all authored clips and controls without development hooks
Space keeps equipped jump, fall and landing on the physics clock, including pause and an unlaunched drop
Shift rolls along its committed direction under lock-on, freezes in pause, and respects the level wall
new game, keyboard movement, jump, roll, camera, pause and responsive HUD
corrupt saves are handled without crashing or enabling Continue
saved checkpoint, key and boss completion persist; new game requires confirmation
synthetic standard Xbox is detected, starts game, moves and pauses on a single edge
combat preview opens paused and deforms the real skin with five independent equipped clips
production combat preview exposes its clips and comparison controls without development hooks
keyboard: equipped combo 1–2–3 follows the controller clock and preserves 1/1/2 damage
mouse: equipped combo 1–2–3 follows the controller clock and preserves 1/1/2 damage
gamepad: equipped combo 1–2–3 follows the controller clock and preserves 1/1/2 damage
real shield input blocks a Brote hit and keeps equipped guard while moving under lock-on
attack pause preserves the exact frame, dodge keeps equipment, and enemy damage uses the safe fallback
real Meshy master loads its skin/materials and plays Walking and Running independently in the inspector
default Ruen breathes with reduced equipment, blends walking and running, and keeps gear through traversal
actual collision displacement freezes Meshy even while the controller requests movement
a failed real model request retains the existing playable Ruen
explicit provisional opt-out keeps the old Ruen without requesting the Meshy master
production loads equipped Ruen automatically and honors the provisional opt-out without debug hooks
a missing runtime shield keeps a neutral real hero playable without partial floating equipment

testCorrection.reason: Initial wall assertion compared the final Idle position with earlier Roll positions. Roll was stationary at z=89.23333333333333 while requesting vz=8, then shorter deceleration substeps reached z=89.31694521136974. The corrected assertion compares consecutive Roll frames with deltaZ<1e-9 and vz>7.99; the clip still advances. Only the failed Shift case was rerun.

sourceIntegrity.basis: final-source.sha256 taken before the browser run

limits: Software-rendered Chromium is functional validation, not an FPS benchmark.
The no-impulse fall starts from a prepared height; the current level has no abrupt ledge.
Gameplay screenshots capture rendered real input frames; the side preview screenshot is an inspector pose.
